summary: The corrected goal 1 HUD has a source-bound visual pass for the reviewed whole native/hosted states: official contextual inspection, complete local instruments, continuous scenery, dominant accessible stars, readable bright-scene labels and protected forecast ink. Fresh isolated Sunny/Studio beginning/end captures pass visual review, and the retained JPEG exports preserve the raw observations. No known current visual failure remains in those states. Earlier native pan stalls remain unresolved interaction evidence; the isolated native pass does not prove their cause or perfect reliability.
reference: docs/design/interface/observatory-game-ui-concept-2026-10-19.png (middle Play screen; concept, not native evidence)
method: Independent whole-viewport image review against the supplied reference and official component roles, separately from coordinator-reported test outcomes. Contrast values below come from read-only decoding of original RGB PNG pixels and sRGB relative-luminance calculations.

convention.raster: 1170x2532 RGB PNG; integer coordinates are original top-left-origin pixels
convention.calculation: Approximate (lighter sRGB relative luminance + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05), rounded to three decimals.
convention.limitation: Local composited pixels adjacent to matching opaque glyph cores are sampled backdrop proxies. They are not an isolated backdrop reconstruction, every glyph/edge, a whole-glyph minimum, a global contrast audit or physical-display certification.
